comment: spell.c chain lightning limits: propagate_chain_lightning() 961-962 and cast_chain_lightning() 1009-1011. A debug-mode Wizard learns chain lightning, raises Pw with blessed potions of gain energy, loads bigrm-1 with #wizloaddes, creates 120 newts with a counted ^G and casts: the chain through the packed newts fills the 100-entry queue (CHAIN_LIGHTNING_LIMIT). She then creates a fog cloud, waits with m-prefixed searches until it engulfs her, and casts again: the spell returns at once because u.uswallow is set.
